notes.title: No Longer Home: Update 1.2.0
notes.notes:
[h2]New[/h2]
[list]
[*] Accessibility options appear on launch for all players after installing the update or if no config file is found.
[*] Added Screen Reader on Windows and MacOS. Windows requires you to download NVDA, a free screen reader. 
[*] Added Linear Navigation, an option to adjust the game to use simple keyboard/controller controls. Auto enabled when Screen Reader is active.
[*] Added Bigger Dialogue Text, an option to toggle between 32pt and 38pt font during dialog and dialog menus.
[*] Added Dyslexic Dialog Font, an option to toggle between Anonymous Pro and OpenDyslexic fonts. Only available when the current language is English.
[*] Added Selection Indicator, an option that adds a visual indicator to discern your selection. Auto disabled when Linear Navigation is active.
[*] Added Use System Cursor, an option to toggle between using NLH's pixel cursor and your system cursor.
[*] Added Fast Skip, skips dialog every 0.3 seconds as long as the button is held. Button is the Space or Enter key on keyboard and mouse and the Run button on controllers.
[/list]
[h2]Changes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Updated Xbox controller icons to be more in line with modern Xbox iconography.
[*] Increased height of dialog and dialog menus to accommodate the bigger dialogue text.
[/list]
[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed issue where pause menu items could not be selected with the mouse during the Bo’s dream sequence while the dialogue menu was hidden.
[*] Fixed instances where Among the Leaves’ dialogue was displayed at the bottom of the screen instead of the top.
[/list]
[h2]Screen Reader Notes[/h2]
[list]
[*] The screen reader's voice and volume cannot be changed within the game, instructions on how to change it below.
[*] Auto skip cannot be enabled when the screen reader is enabled due to limitation to detecting when the Screen Reader finishes speaking.
[*] Text prints all at once when screen reader is enabled, this is so the screen reader properly reads the text.
[*] NVDA users: We recommend you disable "Speak typed characters" under Keyboard in Settings.
[*] MacOS users: We have observed audio issues on MacBook speakers when dialogue starts and finishes, using headphones are recommended
[/list]
[h3]How to adjust Screen Reader Volume and Voice[/h3]
[list]
[*] NVDA: Right click NVDA in the system toolbar and navigate to Preferences > Settings > Speech. 
[*] MacOS: Open System Preferences and navigate to Accessibility > Spoken Content.
[/list] 
[h3]Linear Navigation Notes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Minimal UI is auto enabled when Linear Navigation is enabled. Keyboard/Controller buttons for Auto Skip, Narrative Log, and Pause all still work.
[*] If Screen Reader is disabled Linear Navigation will skip the selection of labels since they have no interaction without the Screen Reader.
[*] While Linear Navigation is enabled, UI will be revealed automatically without needing to navigate the scene.
[/list]
[h3]Linear Navigation Controls[/h3]

notes.title: No Longer Home understands the mythology of the student flat
notes.notes: We once had a neighbour who would hammer, weld, and saw at all hours, prompting my housemate to regularly quote Tom Waits: What's he building in there? We had a lot of theories, but never found out. Whether you're making up stories about what next-door is up to or attributing every unexplained noise to "the ghost", sharehousing seems to have an in-built tendency toward mythmaking... Read more.

notes.title: No Longer Home (formally known as 29) Pricing Update
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30365921/e005bb2e3217a3e1361f2b2b1a8708fae008efa0.png[/img]

Hello!

It's been a little while since we've made an update on Steam. We've been intensely busy developing No Longer Home (formerly known as [i]29[/i]), after a successful Kickstarter campaign. We're really close to finishing the first chapter now and plan to release it this year. It's grown a lot since it's first inception and because of that we decide to make some changes. 

No Longer Home will now be a paid for game. We don't have a price to announce yet, but you can expect to to be around the $20 mark. It will consist of 3 chapters that we plan to release episodically, and the single payment will get you access to all of the chapters. We don't have a set release schedule yet, but we will keep you updated.

notes.title: No Longer Home combines monsters with more adult fears
notes.notes:
Graduating from university and being tossed into the throes of adult life is never easy, but there are certain things that make it that much more difficult. Things like a struggling global economy, worrying about where you’ll end up living, and your flatmate showing up and turning out to be a many-eyed deer-fish-sheep creature all complicate matters, as the currently crowdfunding game No Longer Home wants to explore.

notes.title: 29 Delayed
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30365921/6b0a9562e7ac521667435e43585240f8ab1f55c8.png[/img]



Ok, so as you can tell from the title we’ve got some unfortunate news, here’s the short of it: we’ve decided to delay [b]29[/b]. It’s still coming, don’t worry it’ll just be later than we said it would be. For a myriad of reason (some of which we’ll go into below) [b]29[/b] will now be coming out sometime during [b]early 2018[/b]. Sorry to anyone who’s been excited to play the game, but we promise the it’ll will be much better for it. Thank you for your patience.

While I was in Japan with Hana for Tokyo Game Show we had sometime to talk about the current projection for the game. We concluded that if we wanted it to reach the level of polish we’d be happy with, as well keep our mental and physical health, we’d have to spend some more time on it. This is pretty much entirely because we are a small team, most of whom have other jobs and currently we are unfunded, outside of our [url=https://www.patreon.com/humblegrove]patreon[/url].

This last month has been especially exhausting for Hana and I, but [b]29[/b] is still coming along really nicely and we’re still really excited to be work on it and other ideas we’ve been discussing for the following chapters to [b]No Longer Home[/b].

As always if you have any questions you can tweet at us (or follow for updates) [url=https://twitter.com/humblegrove]@humblegrove[/url] on twitter.

We’ll update you with an revised release date closer to the time. Until then keep being great, don’t crunch and thank you for your support!

Tom&Hana@humblegrove
x

notes.title: Pretty point-and-click 29 out later this month
notes.notes:
29 [official site] tries to capture the emotional rollercoaster that is the last days of university: you’re glad exams are over but, gulp, you actually have to start being an adult. Developers Humble Grove call it a “magical realist point-and-click game”, and from what I can see it’s more focused on letting you soak up the atmosphere than testing your brain with puzzles. You control Bo and Ao as they wander through the flat they’re about to move out of (number 29, hence the name), choosing between dialogue options and piecing together their stories.

It’s currently available in beta through the developer’s Patreon page but the full game is coming out on Steam and Itch.io on September 29th, so not long to wait. Oh, and it’ll be completely free. Yippee!
